segments.name: Lottery
segments.description: Pure-play lottery business providing sales, operations, product development, technology and support to worldwide traditional lottery and iLottery customers.
segments.evidence: The Company operates and manages its continuing operations business as a single segment for the purposes of assessing performance and making operating decisions.

revenueModel.text: Lottery authorities and customers pay for operating and facilities management contracts, systems, software and other services, and product sales.
revenueModel.evidence: Our revenue from operating contracts is derived primarily from long-term exclusive operating licenses in Italy.

changes.text: In 2025 the IGT Gaming business was sold and is presented as a discontinued operation for all periods.
changes.evidence: The Transaction represented a strategic shift that had a major effect on the Company's operations and financial results and accordingly, IGT Gaming is presented in the accompanying Consolidated Financial Statements as a discontinued operation for all periods presented.
